class.name: GodotPhysXTankProbe
class.brief_description: Internal test bridge for a PhysX tracked vehicle.
class.description: Creates a tracked (skid-steer) PxVehicle2 vehicle with any number of road wheels and drives it from a script, for the module's tests. For games use [PhysXTank3D]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal test class of the PhysX module, not a stable API: it may change or be removed without notice.

method.name: get_actor_position
method.description: Returns the world position of the chassis actor's origin.

method.name: get_angular_velocity
method.description: Returns the chassis's angular velocity in world space.

method.name: get_forward
method.description: Returns the chassis's forward direction in world space.

method.name: get_forward_speed
method.description: Returns the speed along the chassis's forward axis, in m/s.

method.name: get_linear_velocity
method.description: Returns the chassis's linear velocity in world space.

method.name: get_position
method.description: Returns the chassis position in world space.

method.name: get_up
method.description: Returns the chassis's up direction in world space.

method.name: get_wheel_jounce
method.description: Returns how far the suspension of road wheel [param wheel] is compressed.

method.name: get_wheel_separation
method.description: Returns the distance between road wheel [param wheel] and the ground; negative when it penetrates the ground.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates the tank at [param position] in the PhysX physics [param space]. [param wheel_positions_local] has one entry per road wheel in the chassis's local space: negative X is the left track, positive X the right track (2 or more wheels). Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: step
method.description: Runs the vehicle simulation for [param dt] seconds. [param left_ratio] and [param right_ratio] in [code][-1, 1][/code] set each track's speed and direction (opposite signs turn on the spot), [param brake] in [code][0, 1][/code].
